content.comment_body: Does anyone know how to fix the display issue with [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10? I've tried adjusting the DPI settings in the compatibility options of the executable, but the display remains tiny (see attached image). I previously changed these settings in [version_no] and the display improved, but they aren't effective for [version_no]. Any suggestions would be appreciated.
Try adjusting the 'Size of text and icons' option.
[user_name], thank you so much! You really saved me a lot of frustration.
I haven't had this issue, but I know what settings are available...

analysis.insight_summary: A user described persistent display scaling problems when running [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10. Adjusting DPI settings in compatibility mode did not resolve the small UI for [version_no], although it helped with an earlier version. Another user's suggestion to change the system 'Size of text and icons' resolved the issue and alleviated significant frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to render properly on Windows 10 with correct scaling, and for display-related solutions like DPI changes to function consistently across different software versions.
